{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias that increases with longer horizons as true prices mean-revert from peak forecast levels",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price changes but model forecasts under-react to strong sentiment (1.00) and over-react to weak sentiment (especially -0.33), creating forecast errors in sentiment-driven days",
    "The forecast error follows a clear pattern: larger differences at day 1-10 (20-30% bias) but errors compress to 5-10% bias by day 20-30 as true prices lag behind forecast levels",
    "When history shows prices declining from the model's starting point, forecasts are too high by 1-2 euros compared to the observed 2-3% daily mean reversion",
    "Sentiment turning negative (0.00 to -0.33) causes model forecasts to remain 1-2 euros above reality while prices quickly retrace 2-3%"
] }
